lib/ reads the clock directly in 176 places. OCP\AppFramework\Utility\ITimeFactory, a PSR-20 ClockInterface, gives the same time and can be replaced in a test.

The app reads and writes its app config in 80 places and registers no config lexicon, which IRegistrationContext::registerConfigLexicon() takes since Nextcloud 31. A lexicon states the type, the default and the sensitivity of each key in one place.

Nothing in the app calls 2 routes outside OCS whose method allows requests from other origins (CORS), or that answer the preflight of such a request (OPTIONS). They are there for clients outside the app, so this is no defect in itself.
